factory.eyebrow: AI FACTORY · FROM IDEA TO PRODUCT
factory.title: Build your product idea.
factory.subtitle: Define the product, design a prototype, plan development and verify delivery.
factory.hint: 選擇工序會將輸入框切換為對應提示詞，可繼續編輯後傳送。

requirements.title: Define product
requirements.description: Identify users, key scenarios and MVP scope
requirements.prompt:
Act as my product manager. Clarify users, problems, scenarios, alternatives and constraints from my materials. Ask about missing information. Deliver an MVP brief with positioning, user journeys, prioritized features, exclusions, page inventory and testable acceptance criteria. Separate assumptions from facts and do not invent research.

Product idea:
Users:
Materials and constraints:

content.title: Design prototype
content.description: Map pages, flows and interaction states
content.prompt:
Act as my product designer. Based on approved requirements, define information architecture, pages and user flows, then create a reviewable interactive prototype. Cover empty, loading, error and success states and responsive layouts. If project tools permit, create a runnable prototype and explain how to preview it. Clearly label mock data and unconnected services.

Approved requirements:
Visual preferences:
Project and constraints:

research.title: Plan development
research.description: Turn the brief into executable tasks
research.prompt:
Act as my technical lead. Inspect the actual project, requirements and prototype before proposing architecture, data models, API contracts, implementation tasks, dependency order, risks and acceptance checks. Distinguish existing features from planned work. Flag code you could not inspect and state assumptions behind estimates.

Requirements and prototype:
Project materials:
Release constraints:

review.title: Verify delivery
review.description: Check features, defects and release readiness
review.prompt:
Act as my acceptance reviewer. Compare the implementation to requirements and mark each criterion passed, failed or unverified with evidence. Check core flows, invalid input, empty states, permissions, persistence and screen sizes where runnable. Deliver prioritized defects, fixes, deliverables and release prerequisites. Never claim unexecuted tests passed or treat a mock prototype as a finished feature.

rea.title: 拆解台
rea.subtitle: Ask about one feature of a shipped application, inspect its static evidence, then trace and explain the relevant relationships.
rea.targetPath: 應用程式目錄或 ASAR 路徑
rea.targetPlaceholder: 請輸入解包應用程式目錄或 app.asar 的絕對路徑
rea.targetHint: Choose a local shipped JavaScript / Electron application directory or ASAR file on the backend machine. For an ordinary complete source repository, use normal project reading. Websites and native binaries are not connected here.
rea.credentialsHint: 應用概覽與功能追蹤在本機執行，無需模型；證據解讀與重建方案需要設定執行助手和模型。
rea.ready: 本機 JS／Electron 靜態分析可用（REA {{version}}）
rea.checkFailed: 無法檢查 REA，請確認後端正常執行後重試。
rea.installHint: REA 尚未就緒。請連按兩下專案目錄中的「配置REA.command」安裝固定版本工具，重新啟動應用程式後再次檢查。此操作不會設定你的其他 Agent。
rea.scopeHint: 靜態取證讀取目標應用程式，不執行目標程式。報告保留證據和未知項；後續 AI 分析可能產生模型呼叫費用。
rea.wrongWorkflow: 此專案屬於另一板塊，請從目前清單選擇專案。
rea.inspectHint: 將使用 REA 靜態分析所填的本機應用程式，不執行目標程式，已有成果版本會保留。
rea.autoHint: 先使用 REA 在本機取證，再呼叫所選助手依序完成後續拆解工序，可能產生模型呼叫費用。所有成果仍需人工審閱。
rea.inspectRunning: REA 正在本機收集靜態證據。可以離開此頁面，任務進度與證據成果會儲存。
rea.transferHint: 選擇目前已儲存、未過期的成果，建立獨立生產專案，並保留來源專案和版本參照。未儲存草稿不會帶入，也不會自動呼叫模型。
rea.evidenceReadOnlyHint: Original overview and trace evidence are generated by REA. Running the relevant tool again creates a new version.
rea.questionExample: Example: Which modules and IPC calls carry the “copy rich text” action from the renderer to the system clipboard?
rea.questionHint: Ask one concrete feature question at a time. State the trigger, expected result and what you want to understand. Tool success means evidence was collected; it does not mean the question is answered.
rea.questionStatusHint: The interpretation must mark each question answered, partially answered or unanswered, with evidence references and remaining gaps.
rea.anchorPlaceholder: Search and select a node actually found in the overview
rea.candidateCount: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} real graph candidates. Search these entries; a missing match does not prove the feature is absent.

directions.incoming: Incoming · what leads to this anchor
directions.outgoing: Outgoing · what this anchor leads to

rea.reconstruct: Prepare a reconstruction plan with AI
rea.restoreFirst: Restore this archived project before investigating.
rea.needOverview: Collect a current application overview before choosing an anchor.
rea.needTrace: Complete a current REA feature trace first. Stale or manually entered text cannot replace tool evidence.
rea.needInterpretation: Generate or save a current evidence interpretation first.
rea.needTool: The local REA tool must be available for this operation.
rea.chooseAnchor: Select a real candidate from the overview before tracing.
rea.noAnchors: No usable anchors are available. Review coverage and limitations; collect a new overview if this is older evidence.
rea.needAssistant: Choose an assistant in project settings for AI interpretation or reconstruction. The two REA tool steps do not require a model.
rea.interpretHint: AI reads the retained overview and trace. It must distinguish static observations, inferences and unknowns, and answer the investigation question with evidence. It does not run the target.
rea.reconstructHint: AI turns evidenced rules into an independent implementation plan. Preserve unanswered questions and verification cases. A plan is not a built or verified product.
rea.aiConfirm: This step uses the configured assistant and model and may incur charges. It interprets existing evidence; it does not collect new runtime behavior.
rea.stoppingHint: Stop requested. Waiting for the backend to confirm the tool or model has ended. Existing saved evidence remains available.
rea.runningStage: {{stage}} is running. You can inspect other sections while this operation continues.
rea.legacyEvidence: This older result has no downloadable evidence metadata. Collect a new overview or trace to obtain the current evidence format.
rea.downloadFailed: Evidence download failed. Retry after checking that the backend and original file are available.
rea.overviewBoundary: An overview is a starting point. Static relationships do not establish runtime execution. Choose a relevant anchor next to investigate the feature.
rea.traceBoundary: Reachable graph nodes may include surrounding modules. They are not all proven participants in the feature; static connectivity does not prove runtime behavior.
rea.partialCandidates: Only part of the anchor list is shown. Return to the overview to download complete evidence, or narrow the target and collect new evidence. An unlisted anchor does not prove the feature is absent.
rea.backendOutdated: 目前執行的後端尚未提供拆解介面。請完全結束 AI 產品加工廠，再透過「启动AI加工厂.command」重新啟動，然後按「重新檢查」。
